what_i_did: The sheet's labels were right (front | side | back as drawn), but the cast shadows ran to the crop edges and counted as object, so prep_views.py paints the low-saturation shadow band out into views/; scores are against views/ (the raw mj folder gives 0.739 for the final model).

After the art director's round, the hero's proportions win over the sheet: a squat round pot whose belly is 0.77 m across (25% wider), about 15% lower, widest about 40% up, with a tucked-in foot. A small collar sits under a lid that overhangs it. The handle top is 1.13 m, about 0.47 of the total height above the lid top.

Every weft row is its own ring strip of 12 puffy blocks (4 vertex rings by 3 columns per block, grooves sunk, crests flat), offset half a block on alternate rows. Blocks alternate over/under puff depth and two straw shades, and are smooth shaded as soft pillows. The lid dome uses the same weave with a slight lumpy irregularity.

The lid is one plump, slightly lumpy pillow: a fat rolled edge overhangs the collar and the woven dome rises out of it. The fat plait handle is three twisted lobes that turn a third per segment, with 16 segment bulges, lashed to lugs on the lid. A big wooden toggle ring (0.25 m across) with a chunky peg sits on the front-right shoulder where the 3/4 view sees it, and rope lashings at the back act as the hinge.

lid_hinge (an empty on the back hinge line, axis X) carries the lid, brim, handle, lugs and sprout: it rests 3 degrees ajar, lifts to 38 degrees by frame 36, wobbles and holds, drops shut with a small bounce at frame 88-98 and settles ajar again at 110-120. The sprout bobs on its own origin (scale and sway, four bobs per loop). One 120-frame 24 fps clip.
good: Reads like the hero: a squat woven pot with a pillowy lid, a tall fat plait and a big wooden toggle (art director round).
The weave is chunky modelled blocks in staggered rows with alternating shades, at 3982 triangles, under the 4k budget.
Straw colour comes from the hero, not the darker sheet.
The lid opens without passing through anything because the handle rides with the lid.
off: IoU against the sheet fell from 0.802 to 0.707. This is deliberate: the sheet draws a taller gourd, and the art director asked for the hero's squat pot. The front and side views lose most (0.66 and 0.70).
The handle is carried by the lid, not the body, so a hinged lid can open without passing through it.
The back view of the sheet shows a flat lid with no dome or sprout; the hero wins.
The plait is a lobed, bulging tube, not separate interleaved strands; it reads as chunky segments at game distance but not up close.
The model is 0.82 m across including the toggle peg, a little over the 0.7 m nominal hamper length, because of the wider belly.
Colour distance to the sheet views stays high by design: the sheet is dark brown, the model uses the hero's straw.

rounds.change: First build: lathe body with 8 rows x 14 puffy blocks, collar, brim, dome, handle on body lugs outside the lid, toggle, sprout.
Moved the handle onto the lid with legs inside the brim (as drawn), narrowed the arch, darker straw, bigger toggle, smaller ajar.
Body radius x0.95 to fix the too-wide aspect, toggle and peg pulled inside the body width, thicker collar and handle, 7 rows x 12 bigger blocks.
Four vertex rings per weave row for flat-topped blocks, closed the collar/brim seam, bigger sprout leaves.
Flat-shaded weave so blocks read as blocks rather than bubbles, taller handle peak.
Sprout moved front-left so the hero view shows it beside the handle (hero over side view), bigger toggle, paler hero straw.
Added rope hinge lashings, trimmed dome blocks and lug segments to stay under 4k triangles; final 768px/48-sample render.

Art director round, with the hero winning over the sheet: squat pot (belly +25% wider, -15% lower, widest ~40% up, tucked foot); the lid merged into one lumpy pillow with a fat overhanging rolled edge; a tall fat plait handle with segment bulges; a 0.25 m toggle ring with a chunky peg moved to the front-right shoulder; smooth-shaded puffs. Final 768px/48-sample render.

moving_parts: lid_hinge (empty on the back hinge line) rotates about X: 3 degrees ajar at rest, lifts to 38 degrees (frames 14-36), holds with a small wobble, drops shut with a bounce (88-98), settles ajar (110-120); the pillow lid, rolled edge, plait handle, lugs and sprout ride on it. The sprout bobs and sways on its own origin with four bobs per loop. Frames 1-120 at 24 fps, seamless, exported as one clip.
creative_additions: Over/under weave with alternating straw shades and puff depths; a shadowed inside of the basket and lid underside that show when the lid opens; rope hinge lashings at the back; a little wooden latch loop opposite the big toggle; the lid's closing bounce.
